contentHtml:
KENYA—AAR Hospital has appointed Maryanne Wambui Kariuki as its new Head of Nursing Services, bringing an experienced nursing leader into a senior role focused on strengthening clinical care, patient safety and service delivery.

Kariuki joins the hospital with extensive experience in clinical operations, nursing services management, patient safety and quality improvement.

Her professional background includes leading multidisciplinary teams and managing healthcare operations in complex clinical environments.

In her new role, she will help strengthen the hospital’s nursing services while supporting efficient, high-quality patient care.

Her experience in nursing leadership positions her to work across clinical and operational functions and support teams in meeting established standards of care.

Focus on quality and patient safety

Throughout her career, Kariuki has worked to improve nursing governance, patient flow and service efficiency.

She has also supported initiatives to strengthen clinical quality and patient safety by adopting evidence-based standards and processes.

Her experience extends beyond clinical operations. She has worked in areas including risk management, regulatory compliance, workforce planning, and performance management.

She has also contributed to process improvement initiatives designed to make healthcare services more efficient and responsive to patients’ needs.

These areas of experience will support her responsibilities at AAR Hospital, particularly as the facility continues to strengthen its nursing operations and maintain standards across its clinical services.

Strengthening nursing teams

Kariuki’s approach to nursing leadership centres on patient-focused care, professional excellence, and continuous improvement.

She also emphasizes developing effective healthcare teams and creating a working environment where staff can collaborate to deliver quality services.

Her leadership experience includes strategic planning, accountability, and multidisciplinary collaboration.

These skills will be important as she works with nursing and clinical teams to improve service delivery and maintain a strong focus on patient safety.

AAR Hospital said Kariuki’s appointment reflects its commitment to strengthening its leadership capacity and advancing patient-centered healthcare.

The hospital also welcomed her to the new position and expressed confidence in the experience and perspective she will bring to its nursing services.

Kariuki’s appointment adds to the hospital’s leadership team at a time when healthcare providers continue to place greater emphasis on quality, efficiency, patient safety and workforce development.

Her responsibilities will include supporting nursing teams and contributing to initiatives that promote consistent standards across patient care services.

The hospital has welcomed Kariuki to her new position and wished her success as she takes on the leadership of its nursing services.
